lead.text: Quadratic ReDoS (catastrophic backtracking) in the regex LITERAL `/( )+$/` at lib/web/fetch/data-url.js:89, inside `dataURLProcessor`. It is applied to `mimeType`, which is taken from the attacker/caller-supplied `data:` URL: `URLSerializer(dataURL, true)` -> `.slice(5)` -> `collectASequenceOfCodePointsFast(',', ...)`, i.e. everything before the first comma, with no length bound. Step 6 of dataURLProcessor strips only LEADING and TRAILING whitespace, so an interior run of spaces survives. Line 89 is gated on line 71 (`/;( ){0,}base64$/i`) matching, which only requires the mimeType to END in `;base64` — it does not require the long space run to be near the end.
